decision_basis: Permanent implementation necessity is not demonstrated by current measured evidence. The existing harness completed one bounded generic ephemeral compatibility execution with 16/16 PASS while remaining unchanged.

opportunity_cost_interpretation.accepted_claim: Keeping the capability ephemeral currently preserves verified test utility without adding a permanent component.
rejected_claims: Permanent implementation will reduce operating cost
opportunity_cost_interpretation.reason_rejected: No measured comparative benchmark or recurring operational workload supports these claims.

terminal_decision_rules.explanation: Evidence is sufficient to defer now, but not sufficient to permanently reject future implementation if operating conditions change.

reopen_conditions: At least one real general runtime consumer requires repeated generic case execution.
A real producer or validated workstream requires the interface beyond bounded manual execution.
Repeated executions demonstrate a measured bottleneck, safety gap, or operational burden in the ephemeral method.
A permanent implementation proposal includes a proven retirement or consolidation plan.
Comparative benchmark demonstrates constitutional improvement without degrading the other goals.
Opportunity Cost gate returns ACCEPT using measured evidence.
